title: Riot Announces New Date for Second Quarter 2026 Earnings Conference Call
description: CASTLE ROCK, Colo., Aug. 09, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Riot Platforms, Inc. (NASDAQ: RIOT) (“Riot” or “the Company”), a leader in vertically integrated digital infrastructure specializing in the development of large-scale data centers and Bitcoin mining applications, announced today that it has rescheduled the second quarter 2026 earnings conference call for Monday, August 10, 2026, at 4:30 P.M. EST.
